25:     },
26:     update() {

29:       if (this.y + this.h >= groundY) {
30:         this.y = groundY - this.h;
31:         this.vy = 0;
32:         this.onGround = true;
33:       } else {
34:         this.onGround = false;
35:       }
36:     },
37:     jump() {
38:       if (this.onGround) {
39:         this.vy = JUMP_VELOCITY;
40:         this.onGround = false;
41:       }
42:     },
43:   };

45:   const groundY = HEIGHT - 50;
46:   const obstacles = [];
47:   let frame = 0;
48:   let gameOver = false;
49: 
50:   function spawnObstacle() {
51:     // Randomly spawn a spike or a gap (gap represented by a longer floor skip)
52:     const type = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'spike' : 'gap';
53:     const x = WIDTH + 20;
54:     if (type === 'spike') {
55:       obstacles.push({ type: 'spike', x, y: groundY - 20, w: 20, h: 20 });
56:     } else {
57:       // gap: just push a marker; when player reaches it, floor disappears for a short span
58:       obstacles.push({ type: 'gap', x, width: 80, passed: false });
59:     }
60:   }
61: 
62:   function updateObstacles() {
63:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
64:       const o = obstacles[i];
65:       o.x -= SPEED;
66:       // Remove off‑screen
67:       if (o.x + (o.w || o.width) < -20) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
68:     }
69:     // Spawn new obstacles every 120 frames
70:     if (frame % 120 === 0) spawnObstacle();
71:   }
72: 
73:   function drawFloor() {
74:     ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
75:     // Determine if a gap covers current floor segment
76:     let gapActive = false;
77:     for (const o of obstacles) {
78:       if (o.type === 'gap' && o.x < WIDTH && o.x + o.width > 0) {
79:         // Draw floor before gap
80:         ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, o.x, 10);
81:         // Skip drawing over gap, then draw remainder after gap
82:         ctx.fillRect(o.x + o.width, groundY, WIDTH - (o.x + o.width), 10);
83:         gapActive = true;
84:         break;
85:       }
86:     }
87:     if (!gapActive) ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, WIDTH, 10);
88:   }
89: 
90:   function drawObstacles() {
91:     ctx.fillStyle = '#a00';
92:     for (const o of obstacles) {
93:       if (o.type === 'spike') {
94:         ctx.beginPath();
95:         ctx.moveTo(o.x, o.y + o.h);
96:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y);
97:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w, o.y + o.h);
98:         ctx.closePath();
99:         ctx.fill();
100:       }
101:     }
102:   }
103: 
104:   function checkCollision() {
105:     for (const o of obstacles) {
106:       if (o.type === 'spike') {
107:         const hit =
108:           player.x < o.x + o.w &&
109:           player.x + player.w > o.x &&
110:           player.y < o.y + o.h &&
111:           player.y + player.h > o.y;
112:         if (hit) return true;
113:       }
114:       if (o.type === 'gap') {
115:         // Gap collision handled by floor missing; if player is falling below ground while over gap
116:         const overGap = player.x + player.w > o.x && player.x < o.x + o.width;
117:         if (overGap && player.y + player.h >= groundY) {
118:           // Player is on missing floor
119:           return true;
120:         }
121:       }
122:     }
123:     return false;
124:   }
125: 
126:   function loop() {
127:     if (gameOver) {
128:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
129:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
130:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
131:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
132:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH / 2 - 60, HEIGHT / 2);
133:       return;
134:     }
135:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
136:     drawFloor();
137:     player.update();
138:     player.draw();
139:     updateObstacles();
140:     drawObstacles();
141:     if (checkCollision()) gameOver = true;
142:     frame++;
143:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
144:   }
145: 
146:   // Input
147:   window.addEventListener('click', () => player.jump());
148:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.code === 'Space') player.jump(); });
149: 
150:   // Start
151:   loop();
152: })();
